description: Threpoly helps operations teams understand the health, availability, performance and security of managed file transfers. Review current incidents, heartbeat and expected-file monitoring, SLA and performance trends, workflow and capacity tests, security recommendations, and safe SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS and AS2 trading-partner configuration. Access is read-only and limited to your organisation’s Threpoly data.

defaultPrompt: Give me an executive summary of the current health, recent SLA, active incidents, and security posture for [application name].
Are any monitored applications or expected file transfers currently experiencing an outage? Summarize the impact and duration.
Review my configured capacity tests and summarize their current status, recent results, and performance trends.
